'''Frog Knight''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Glory}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Frog Knight}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Tongue Lash
|Intent = Attack2, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|14}}) damage. Applies 2 {{BD2|Frail}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Strike Down Evil
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (21;{{Asc2|9|23}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = For the Queen
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 5 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Beetle Charge
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (35;{{Asc2|9|40}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Opens with {{Int2|Frog Knight|Tongue Lash}}, then follows a repeating cycle: {{Int2|Frog Knight|Strike Down Evil}}, {{Int2|Frog Knight|For the Queen}}, then a conditional check.

If the Frog Knight's HP is below half and it has not yet used {{Int2|Frog Knight|Beetle Charge}}, it uses {{Int2|Frog Knight|Beetle Charge}} once, then continues with {{Int2|Frog Knight|Tongue Lash}}. Otherwise, it uses {{Int2|Frog Knight|Tongue Lash}} and continues the cycle.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Frog Knight''' rides on a smaller version of the {{M2|Slumbering Beetle}}.
